title: “Upload ID to unlock your account”
scenario: A message says your shopping account is temporarily locked and asks you to upload a photo of your driver’s licence plus a selfie to restore access. The link opens a page that looks identical to the retailer.

answers.A: Upload the selfie first but wait to send the licence until the account status changes.
answers.B: Open the retailer app/site yourself and use its account-recovery process or support channel.
answers.C: Check whether the account is actually locked by signing in independently before providing any documents.

explanation: A convincing page can collect an identity bundle for future fraud. First prove the account problem exists.
proTip: Verify the problem before proving your identity.
